newsitem.title: USA: Input/Output sees FY97 net $16m after charges.
newsitem.headline: Input/Output sees FY97 net $16m after charges.

text.p: Input/Output Inc said Thursday it expects to report net earnings for the fiscal year of about $16 million after year-end charges of about $10.6 million.
The company said that these charges, approximating $0.24 per share, reduced net earnings per share for the fiscal year to about $0.38.
It said it expects to report revenues for its fiscal year ended May 31, 1997 of about $280 million.
The charges include an increase in the company's allowance for doubtful accounts and notes receivable, a writedown of capitalized exploration costs and expenses incurred in organizational changes.
